name: Rossell Techsys Ltd
tagline: Defence/aerospace interconnect and MRO supplier (demerged from Rossell India) posting explosive 145% YoY revenue growth on the Make-in-India defence-indigenization wave, but with weak ROCE (~7%), thin margins and a rich ~30x book valuation.
business_overview: Rossell Techsys Ltd (NSE: ROSSTECH), demerged/listed out of Rossell India, supplies interconnect solutions, limited manufacturing services, repair/rework of electrical panels and sub-assemblies, and test/after-market services for military aerospace and defence platforms. Entity confirmed via screener.in (ticker ROSSTECH). Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@rishithegreat41, medium conviction).
fundamentals_narrative: Revenue growth is extraordinary (144.95% YoY, Q2 FY26) and reflects a real structural tailwind - India's defence-indigenization push is driving qualified domestic suppliers of military-aerospace interconnects and MRO services. But profitability has not caught up: 3-year average ROCE is only ~7.2% ('inefficient capital deployment' per one source) and ROE just 10.4%, net margin is thin (~4.7%), leverage is above industry average (D/E 1.82), and the stock already trades at ~29.7x book value. This is a growth-stage defence supplier where the market is pricing in future margin/return expansion that hasn't shown up in the numbers yet.
